aviation_comparison.relative_position: Aviation operates strictly below the ozone layer in the troposphere.

satellite_comparison.relative_position: Satellites orbit in the vacuum above the mesosphere and thermosphere, looking downward through the ozone column.

codebase_units_audit.shader_scaling: frontend/src/lib/satellite-layer.ts scales altitude into FLOOR_KM=620 to CEILING_KM=2500 for WebGL rendering.
codebase_units_audit.reconciliation_rule: Aircraft altitude (m) * 0.001 = km. Satellites operate 15x to 3,500x higher than jet flight ceilings.
